objective: Collect genuine multi-step LLM traces under a frozen pilot protocol, then test whether learned ThinkGate decisions reduce compute while preserving quality.

collection_protocol.name: pilot-numeric-v1
collection_protocol.refinement_prompt: Review the previous answer for arithmetic, reasoning, or interpretation errors and improve it if needed.
collection_protocol.quality_scorer: graded_numeric_v1: exact answer=1; otherwise 1/(1+relative_error); missing FINAL=0
collection_protocol.latency_policy: recorded for analysis but not included in pilot utility cost
collection_protocol.claim_policy: Pilot validates end-to-end collection/calibration only; it is not broad evidence of general adaptive-compute performance.

estimator.leakage_rule: No eval task contributes to estimator fitting or margin selection.

split_policy.leakage_rule: All steps from the same task_id remain in one split.

success_rule: SUCCESS only if all three frozen gates pass on the untouched eval split.
evidence_status: No real-world performance claim until genuine provider-generated traces are collected and evaluated.
